verdict.rationale: Quo documents its own message webhooks in a full webhooks API ("Creates a new webhook that triggers on events from messages"), which covers receiving message events programmatically. Sending a text from a Quo number is documented through its official MCP server, but the pack never shows a REST send-message endpoint or names delivery-status event types. missing for 10: an explicitly documented API send-SMS endpoint, documented delivery-status (sent/delivered/failed) callback events, an inbound-SMS event payload, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can send and receive SMS on the number through the API with delivery status callbacks

citations.quote: Creates a new webhook that triggers on events from messages.
